description: This file defines the 'Config' class within the 'Thunder::PluginHost' namespace, including nested classes for configuration management, path substitution, and server setup. It contains declarations for configuration parameters, methods for updating network bindings, and handling plugin configurations.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class managing server settings, paths, network interfaces, plugins, and security.

classes.name: Config::Substituter
classes.description: Handles variable substitution in configuration paths using delimiters.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig
classes.description: JSON-based container for server configuration parameters, including nested classes for process and input configurations.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::ProcessSet
classes.description: Represents process-related configuration options such as user, group, priority, and thread counts.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::InputConfig
classes.description: Defines input handler configuration including locator, type, and output enablement.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::Observables
classes.description: Contains paths for proxy stub and plugin configuration.

methods.name: Config::UpdateBinder
methods.description: Updates network binding address based on interface and configuration.

methods.name: Config::Security
methods.description: Sets the security interface for the configuration.

methods.name: Config::Plugins
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the plugin configurations.

methods.name: Config::Add
methods.description: Adds a new plugin configuration if not already present.

methods.name: Config::UpdateAccessor
methods.description: Resolves and updates the network address for server access.
